title: Where in the world are you from?
content: Hi all, this is by far my favorite sub. The idea of a shared dream space is absolutely mind blowing! Even more so in realizing that this shared dream space is being navigated by us all to the point of being able to give each other directions on locations that we all know and are familiar with. On that note, I am curious as to where you all are from. For instance, I am from the USA. What country are you currently residing in?
